notes: Starter dataset. Every rate/cap below should be re-verified against the issuer MITC before shipping. Fields marked _verify are from secondary sources only.
_merchants_note: Where you are spending, not just what on. This matters because several
accelerated rates only apply at named merchants - Axis ACE pays 4% on
Swiggy, Zomato and Ola but 1.5% on any other food delivery - and the
engine can only apply those rows when it is told the merchant.
The id is what gets matched against the 'merchants' lists inside
category_rates, so it must stay lowercase and must not be renamed
casually. The category is the one the merchant's spend falls under.
This is a merchant directory, not reward data. Adding a merchant here
never changes what a card pays - it only lets the engine see a rate row
that was already in the dataset.
